title: Acquirer: Alcan South Pacific Pty Limited; Target: Pechiney SA

body_sections.Summary: Proposed acquisition globally by Alcan of Pechiney.
body_sections.Market definition: The national markets for Bauxite, Alumina and Aluminium. The national market for engineered products. The national market for flat-rolled products. The national market for packaging.
body_sections.Competition analysis: Due to global factors, there would not appear to be any substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets.
